title: Export button on Day0 and on a later frozen day

steps.do: Open the Daily Report on 14 Feb 2026 (?date=2026-02-14), previous arrow disabled, read date and Freeze button
steps.why: Header date 14 Feb 2026, previous-day arrow disabled, button reads Unfreeze (day frozen).

steps.do: Look at Export button and Gantt on 14 Feb 2026
steps.expected: Export is ENABLED (QA lead 26 Nov: Day0 must be exportable even with no tasks). Note whether the day has tasks
steps.why: Export button is DISABLED on 14 Feb 2026 (button disabled=true, snapshot [disabled]). Gantt has no task rows (only the header row, 0 task bars). Expected enabled, so Day0 is not exportable.

steps.do: Press next-day arrow once (15 Feb 2026) and look at Export
steps.why: Comparison: on 15 Feb 2026 (Day 1) Export is ENABLED, day has 12 task rows (e.g. 8042281772 QA 8042). Day0 disabled vs Day 1 enabled.
